components.pubsub.yaml:
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: pubsub
spec:
  type: pubsub.redis
  version: v1
  metadata:
    - name: redisHost
      value: '127.0.0.1:59543'
    - name: redisPassword
      value: ''
components.statestore.yaml:
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: statestore
spec:
  type: state.redis
  version: v1
  metadata:
    - name: redisHost
      value: '127.0.0.1:59543'
    - name: redisPassword
      value: ''
    - name: actorStateStore
      value: 'true'
    - name: keyPrefix
      value: none

discovery:
apiVersion: dapr.io/v1alpha1
kind: Configuration
metadata:
  name: isolated-admission
spec:
  nameResolution:
    component: sqlite
    version: v1
    configuration:
      connectionString: "/tmp/eventstore-actor-admission-1yoh7cq0/discovery.sqlite"
